download Manual Backup

Backup data on your device as a JSON export file

No automatic sync across devices. Data is stored locally, and clearing browser cache deletes your local data.

cloud_sync Automatic Backup

Backup data automatically to your Google Drive AppData folder

Connect using the same account on other devices for automatic sync. Mobile/tablet sessions need to be reconnected after token expiry.
